archetype: Archetype 3: Pastel & Soft (E1 Clay & Crisp Neumorphism)
design_philosophy: A visually clean, highly scannable, low-stress internal tool for busy staff. Utilizing a refined 'Clay & Crisp' Neumorphism that relies on subtle light/dark shadow interplay grounded by 1px crisp borders, avoiding the muddy aesthetics of typical soft UIs.

typography.rationale: Manrope brings structural geometric personality (anti-default) to headers without feeling childish. Work Sans is highly optimized for on-screen legibility, essential for staff quickly reading ingredient lists and step-by-step prep.

neumorphic_card.description: Clay & Crisp protruding surface. Soft shadows grounded by a sharp 1px border. No muddy gray.

neumorphic_pressed.description: Inset shadow for active states like Size Toggles or Active Tabs.

glassmorphism_modal.description: Optical Clarity for the password modal and sticky header.
glassmorphism_modal.classes: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] rounded-3xl

header.layout: sticky top-0 z-50 py-4 px-6 md:px-12 flex justify-between items-center glassmorphism_modal rounded-none border-t-0 border-l-0 border-r-0 border-b-white/40
header.wordmark: font-black text-3xl tracking-tighter lowercase text-[#2C2C2A] drop-shadow-sm select-none
header.edit_toggle_btn: px-6 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-300 neumorphic_card hover:-translate-y-0.5
header.edit_toggle_btn_active: px-6 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-300 neumorphic_pressed text-[#2C2C2A] bg-[#F3D899]

menu_cards.layout: neumorphic_card p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col gap-6 h-full
menu_cards.typography: Left-aligned content for scannability. Item Name in Manrope H3. Ingredients in Work Sans text-base.
menu_cards.spacing: gap-4 between visual sections. Use a subtle divider (h-px bg-black/5) between Ingredients and Steps.
menu_cards.steps_list: flex flex-col gap-3 list-decimal list-inside marker:text-[#B2C9AB] marker:font-bold

size_toggle.pill_default: px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-[#7A7A75] hover:text-[#2C2C2A] transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer
size_toggle.pill_active: px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-[#2C2C2A] bg-[#B2C9AB] shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 cursor-default pointer-events-none

category_tabs.layout: flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-6 pt-2 px-2 -mx-2 hide-scrollbar
category_tabs.tab_default: neumorphic_card px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#7A7A75] hover:text-[#2C2C2A] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer
category_tabs.tab_active: neumorphic_pressed px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#2C2C2A] bg-[#F4F3EF] whitespace-nowrap cursor-default pointer-events-none

edit_mode.indicator_global: When active, inject a fixed floating pill bottom-center: 'EDIT MODE ON' in bg-[#F3D899] text-black shadow-lg rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold tracking-widest.
edit_mode.inline_fields: Editable text elements get a dashed bottom border (border-b-2 border-dashed border-[#E8B4A2]/50). On hover: bg-white/40 rounded px-2 -ml-2 transition-all cursor-text.
edit_mode.add_delete_actions: Show 'Add Item' empty card at end of grid (dashed outline, + icon). Show tiny 'Delete' icon (lucide-react Trash) top-right of existing cards in soft red.

password_modal.layout: fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-[#F4F3EF]/60 backdrop-blur-md
password_modal.card: glassmorphism_modal p-10 max-w-sm w-full mx-4 flex flex-col gap-6 items-center text-center
password_modal.input: w-full text-center tracking-[0.5em] text-3xl font-black text-[#2C2C2A] bg-[#F4F3EF] rounded-2xl py-4 shadow-[inset_4px_4px_8px_#e5e4e0,inset_-4px_-4px_8px_#ffffff] outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#B2C9AB] border border-black/5

spacing_scale.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12
spacing_scale.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-8 lg:gap-12
spacing_scale.generous_philosophy: Utilize p-6 and p-8 internally on cards. Elements must have breathing room to reduce cognitive load for busy staff.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) if protruding, or deepen shadow if inset. Duration 300ms ease-out.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Smooth number interpolations for ingredient quantities when Size Toggle is clicked.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: Forms/inputs focus state must ring with #B2C9AB (Accent Matcha).

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. Examples: data-testid='size-toggle-s', data-testid='category-tab-smoothies', data-testid='edit-mode-btn', data-testid='menu-item-card-name', data-testid='save-btn'
